Advantages.subtitle: We don't just write code — we create tools for your business growth. No overpayments, delays or stress.
Advantages.ctaAriaLabel: Open form to discuss the project

advantage1.title: No empty promises — only real deadlines
advantage1.description: We know how tiring 'ready tomorrow' from other contractors is. We set clear deadlines before the start and stick to them. Average landing page development time is 7-10 days, complex project — up to 4 weeks.

advantage2.title: Your website will find customers, not gather dust in Google
advantage2.description: Many web studios make 'pretty pictures' but forget the main thing — attracting customers. We embed SEO optimization and analytics at the development stage so your website works for results right away.

advantage3.title: Transparency at every step
advantage3.description: No surprises with cost or functionality. You see the development process in real time, receive reports and can make changes at any stage. Telegram/WhatsApp always in touch.

advantage4.title: Website that works on all devices
advantage4.description: In 2025, 70% of users come from phones. We create responsive websites that look perfect on smartphones, tablets and computers. Fast loading + convenient navigation = more sales.

advantage5.title: Technologies that won't become outdated in a year
advantage5.description: We use a modern technology stack (React, Next.js, Node.js) that is easy to scale and maintain. Your website will be relevant for years, not require a complete overhaul tomorrow.

advantage6.title: Post-launch support — free for a month
advantage6.description: The first month after launch, technical support, minor bug fixes and consultations are free. We don't disappear after payment.

Process.title: How we build your website
Process.subtitle: A transparent process — from the first conversation to the launch of the finished project. You always know what stage the work is at and what result you will get.

brief.title: Project brief
brief.text:
We discuss your goals, business specifics and wishes.
We define the structure of the future website, the pages, features and materials needed.

design.title: Design
design.text:
We create a custom design that reflects your brand and your audience's needs.

We plan the page structure, navigation and usability, and approve the mockups before development starts.

development.title: Development
development.text: We turn the approved design into a fully functional website: the agreed features, mobile adaptation and the integrations you need. We set up the technical side of the site.

launch.title: Launch & handover
launch.text: We test the website on different devices and set up the domain, hosting and SSL certificate. Then we publish the finished project and hand over all the accesses.

Faq.title: Website development FAQ
Faq.subtitle: Answers to the most common questions about building a website, development costs and launching the finished project.

start.question: How does the work start?
start.answer: It all starts with discussing your idea. We clarify the website's goals, the features you need, your design preferences and budget. Then we suggest the best solution, agree on the price and get to work.

price.question: How much does a website cost?
price.answer: The price depends on the type of website, the number of pages and the features. Starting prices are listed in the «Services & pricing» section above, and we will give you an exact quote after a short discussion of your project. You can also get an estimate with the calculator on our website.

codeVsBuilder.question: What is the difference between custom code and a website builder?
codeVsBuilder.answer: A website builder is faster to launch, but you are limited to what the platform allows. A custom-coded website is faster, has no limits on design or features, and is better for SEO and future growth. We will help you choose the option that fits your goals and budget.

mobile.question: Will the website work well on phones?
mobile.answer: Yes. Every website we build is adapted for smartphones, tablets and desktops, and we test it on different devices and browsers before launch.

prepare.question: What do I need to prepare to get started?
prepare.answer: Just tell us about your business and what the website should do. If you have a logo, brand colors, texts or photos — great; if not, we will tell you what is needed and help you prepare the materials.

afterLaunch.question: What do I get after the launch?
afterLaunch.answer: A finished website on your domain with an SSL certificate, working request forms and all the accesses to the site and hosting. After the launch we stay in touch and help with support and changes.

CalculatorPage.calculatorTitle: Calculate the cost of your website

guide.title: How the calculator works and what a website price is made of
guide.intro: The ABECT calculator shows an estimated website development cost before your first call with a manager. Its rates are set by our team — they are the base prices we use to build an estimate. The result helps you plan a budget, compare options and come to a consultation with concrete numbers.

sections.title: How we calculate the cost: the formula
text: The price is built from five parts — the same way as in the estimate we prepare manually:
list: Base price — depends on the project type (landing page, corporate website, online store, web app) and the platform. The base price already includes one page.
Pages — each additional page adds a fixed amount. A page on the Weblium builder costs less than in custom development.
Extra services — SEO optimization, copywriting, multilingual support, CRM and payment integrations, animations, technical support. Each has a fixed price added to the total.
Urgency — a coefficient applied to the whole amount: urgent development costs more because the team reschedules other work; a flexible timeline gives a discount.
Minimum order — if the total is below the minimum, the calculator shows the minimum project cost.

sections.title: Weblium or custom code: which to choose
text: Weblium is a website builder with ready-made blocks. A site on it launches faster and costs less, and you can edit texts and photos without a developer. It is a good choice for an ad landing page, a business card site or a small corporate website.

Custom development means unique design and code with no platform limits: fast loading, flexible SEO, complex catalogs, user accounts and integrations with any service. Web apps are available only this way. It costs more, but the site grows with your business without moving to another platform.

sections.title: What affects the website price
text: The calculator takes into account the main factors behind any website budget:
list: scope — the number of pages and unique templates;
functionality — catalog, cart, payments, filters, user account;
content — whether texts and photos are ready or need to be created;
languages — each language means translation and separate SEO settings;
integrations — CRM, payment systems, delivery services, external APIs;
timeline — tight deadlines require more team resources.

sections.title: What is included in the price
text: The base price of every project covers everything needed for launch:
list: custom design adapted for phones and tablets;
building the site on the chosen platform — Weblium or code;
lead forms with Telegram notifications, so no client gets lost;
SSL certificate, technical SEO and registering the site in Google;
launch on your domain and handover of all access.

sections.title: Why the price is shown as "from"
text: The calculator estimates a typical project of the chosen format. The final cost depends on details that cannot be covered in a few steps: design complexity, the number of unique blocks, integration specifics. So the result is the lower limit of the budget, and we fix the exact price in an estimate after a short brief. Domain and hosting are paid separately.

sections.title: What happens after the calculation
text: At the last step, leave your name and phone or email — the request with all selected options goes straight to our team. We will contact you, clarify the task, suggest the best format and prepare an exact estimate with a timeline. The calculation is not binding: you can simply check the cost and come back later — the calculator remembers your choices in this browser.

faq.q: How accurate is the website cost calculator?
faq.a: It uses the same rates we start an estimate with, so it gives a realistic lower limit of the budget. The exact price depends on design, content and integrations and is fixed after a brief.

faq.q: How much does a landing page, corporate website or online store cost?
faq.a: Choose the project type and platform in the calculator — it instantly shows the "from" price for that option. The most affordable path is a landing page on Weblium; the most expensive is a custom-built web app.
No, domain and hosting are paid separately. We will help you choose and set them up.

faq.q: Why does urgent development cost more?
faq.a: To deliver faster, the team reschedules other work and runs several stages in parallel, so an urgency coefficient is applied to the total. If your timeline is flexible, the calculator gives a discount instead.

faq.q: How long does website development take?
faq.a: The calculator shows an estimated timeline after you choose the urgency. It depends on scope and functionality: a landing page on a builder launches fastest, while an online store or a custom web app takes longer.

faq.q: Can I change the options after the calculation?
faq.a: Yes. Go back to any step with the "Back" button or press "Start Over" — the price is recalculated instantly. At the consultation we will pick the best option for your budget together.

faq.q: What if my type of website is not in the calculator?
faq.a: Choose the closest option or send a request via the "Discuss Project" form — we will estimate a non-standard project individually.
